beats.event: The world's birds gather to choose a sovereign
The hoopoe proposes they seek the hidden Simorgh
The hoopoe names the seven valleys that lie ahead
The flock bows in distress; some birds die of fright
Nightingale, parrot, peacock, and duck each plead excuses
The hoopoe answers every objection; the flock resolves to fly
They set out on the arduous journey together
Valley of the Quest: dogma and unbelief are shed
Valley of Love: reason is forsaken for pure longing
Valley of Knowledge: worldly learning is exposed as useless
Valley of Detachment: desires fall away and reality dissolves
Many die of thirst, heat, illness, or wild beasts on the way
Valley of Unity: all seeming multiplicity resolves into one
Valley of Wonderment: bewilderment before divine beauty
Valley of Poverty and Annihilation: the ego dissolves entirely
Only thirty birds survive to reach the Simorgh's court
They see: 'si morgh' means 'thirty birds'; they are what they sought
